definitions.explanation: Describes a state of good health and vitality. Commonly used in greetings to ask how someone is doing.
Describes someone who is full of energy and vigor.

examples.notes: Standard response to お元気ですか

examples.japanese: {元気|げんき}な{子供|こども}ですね。

notes: One of the most important words for basic conversation. お{元気|げんき}ですか is the standard 'How are you?' greeting. Can be used as both a na-adjective and a noun. When someone looks down, you might encourage them with {元気|げんき}を{出|だ}して (cheer up!).
